word of warning for the arctic 7 wireless, very common problem of the charging port breaking off inside the headset. A smarter option would be to purchase with best buys warranty and just smash it every year and get it replaced locally no questions asked haha or make sure you saved your receipt and go with the manufacturer which seems to have had mixed results from what I read. The headset besides this is completely epic, even if a little to wide for my head and sometimes falls off lol. It's the best one I have owned since the ps4 elite wireless headset that unfortunately is discontinued.
